approved_devices.name: CGuard Carotid Embolic Prevention System (CGuard EPS)
approved_devices.platform: Self-expanding nitinol carotid stent with MicroNet mesh sleeve
approved_devices.regulatory_status: CE Mark recertified under EU MDR (Jan 2024); marketed in 30+ countries ex-US

approved_devices.name: CGuard Prime Carotid Stent System
approved_devices.platform: Same stent / MicroNet mesh as CGuard EPS with differentiated deployment mechanism
approved_devices.regulatory_status: FDA PMA approval received June 2025; U.S. commercial launch July 2025

active_pivotal_ide_studies.device: CGuard Prime 80 cm carotid stent system used during TCAR (transcarotid revascularization)
active_pivotal_ide_studies.design: Multicenter, single-arm, pivotal IDE study; 50 patients enrolled
active_pivotal_ide_studies.trial_status: Enrollment completed Q1 2026; ACTIVE (RECRUITING per ctgov record, pending status update)
key_milestones: Intended to support U.S. label expansion of CGuard Prime to TCAR

active_pivotal_ide_studies.device: SwitchGuard NPS (proprietary neuroprotection system) paired with CGuard Prime 80 cm for TCAR with flow-reversal neuroprotection
active_pivotal_ide_studies.trial_status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING; IDE submitted to FDA December 30, 2024; enrollment expected to begin Q2 2026

active_pivotal_ide_studies.trial_name: CGuard Prime EFS in Acute Ischemic Stroke
active_pivotal_ide_studies.device: CGuard Prime carotid stent in acute ischemic stroke

excluded_legacy_terminated.name: MGuard Prime EPS (legacy coronary stent program)
excluded_legacy_terminated.reason: Withdrawn / terminated coronary stent trials from prior MGuard program; superseded by carotid focus.

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Medical-device company specializing in carotid stents (CGuard EPS, CGuard Prime) and neuroprotection (SwitchGuard NPS). No proprietary drug or biologic pipeline; clinical activity consists of device pivotal/IDE studies with phase=NA on ClinicalTrials.gov, which fall outside the P1/P2/P3 drug-pipeline scope. Active pivotal device studies are recorded under commercial_product.active_pivotal_ide_studies.
